description: This file defines the ConvertDecimal class, which provides static methods to convert decimal numbers to binary, hexadecimal, and octal representations, including handling array inputs and specific formatting rules.

classes.name: ConvertDecimal
classes.description: Provides static methods for converting decimal numbers to binary, hexadecimal, and octal formats, suitable for use within Excel functions, including handling special cases and array inputs.

methods.name: toBinary
methods.description: Converts a decimal value to its binary representation, supporting a specified number of places, with support for array inputs and error handling.

methods.name: toHex
methods.description: Converts a decimal value to its hexadecimal representation, supporting a specified number of places, with array input support and error handling.

methods.name: hex32bit
methods.description: Handles 32-bit formatting for hexadecimal values, especially for negative or large numbers, ensuring correct two's complement representation.

methods.name: toOctal
methods.description: Converts a decimal value to its octal representation, supporting array inputs and proper error handling.

methods.name: validateDecimal
methods.description: Validates whether the input string represents a valid decimal number, throws exception if invalid.
